sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains how the service of Israel with the four letters of Havayah in the soul unites the two names, detailing the Yud as self-nullification, the first Hei as contemplation of limited revelation, the Vav as Torah study, and the final Hei as mitzvah performance.

translations.translation: And the maamar continues,
that according to what is explained elsewhere,
that “Our G-d” is the name Havayah that is in each and every Jew,
“the portion of Havayah is His people,”
it is understood even more that “Our G-d” connects the two names,
for through the service of Israel with the four letters of Havayah in the soul,
the connection of the two names is made,
so that in the lower Havayah the revelation of the upper Havayah shines.
And he explains there,
that the matter of the Yud of the name Havayah in the soul is the placing of one’s essence,
that he lays himself down entirely to G-dliness and does not consider his intellect.
Not only that even when his intellect obligates otherwise he does not consider this
(including also that he does not consider that they will say of him that his conduct is contrary to intellect),
but beyond this,
that this placing of himself to G-dliness is not because his intellect obligates this
(as explained elsewhere
that the intellect itself obligates that there are matters above intellect),
but rather,
that he places himself to G-dliness without any calculations.
And the matter of the first Hei is the contemplation of how all the revelations in the worlds,
even the revelation of Sovev Kol Almin and certainly the revelation of Memaleh Kol Almin,
are only a radiation that was drawn through many and many tzimtzumim.
And through this it becomes very narrow for him,
it becomes very constricted for him,
and especially when he contemplates his particular standing and situation, how he is distant from G-dliness
[the reason for this being that he is in such a situation is because the light and revelation that shines in the totality of the worlds is only a contracted radiation,
for the more the radiation is drawn downward, the more it is contracted,
and this is the reason that he comes to such a situation],
from which it becomes even narrower for him,
it becomes so constricted for him until he finds no place.
And it can be said,
that in order for this understanding and comprehension to be truly settled within him
(that it should be laid down),
there must first be the bittul of placing one’s essence.
For since the intellect is a something,
behold, from the intellect itself it is impossible for it to truly be settled within him
(to the extent that it will be narrow for him from this)
how all the existence of the entire hishtalshelus is distant, etc.,
therefore there must first be the bittul of placing one’s essence, which is above intellect,
the matter of the Yud,
a mere point,
and this also affects the intellect to align with the point,
a point in a heichal.
And the matter of the Vav of the name Havayah in the soul is the matter of engaging in Torah.
For after the contemplation
(the service of the first Hei)
that all the revelations in the worlds are only a contracted radiation,
from which it becomes very narrow for him
(as above),
behold, “and they cried out to Havayah when they were in distress,”
that he cries out
(and prays)
to Havayah for the revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof that is above tzimtzum,
and this brings him to engage in Torah,
for through this the revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof shines to him.
For although “the Torah emanates from Chochmah,”
behold, the precise point of the Baal HaHilula is known
(of the 24th of Teves),
that from this very language
(“the Torah emanates from Chochmah,”
“emanates” specifically)
it is understood that the root of the Torah is the Supernal Will etc. that is above Chochmah,
and only afterward it comes into Chochmah and from there it emanates in the aspect of revelation.
And the matter of the final Hei of the name Havayah in the soul is the performance of mitzvos,
which comes after the service of Vav,
Torah,
for in order to fulfill the mitzvos properly,
one must know the deed that he should do.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that although mitzvah performance is lower than Torah study, it has a superiority because the will for mitzvos is not clothed in any thing, and through mitzvos one attains greater understanding in Torah.

translations.translation: And behold, even though the service of performing mitzvos is the final Hei, lower than engaging in Torah which is the Vav,
nevertheless, from this very fact it is understood
that there is a superiority in mitzvos over Torah.
And as explained at length in the aforementioned maamar,
that the Torah,
even though its root is the Supernal Will etc. that is above Chochmah
(as above),
behold, the will of Torah is clothed in Chochmah,
for from this it is proven
that this will
(even before its clothing in Chochmah)
is a will that is composed in some thing,
in contrast, the will for mitzvos is a will that is not composed in any thing.
For the will for mitzvos is specifically in actual deed,
because actual deed
(in physicality)
is not at all comparable,
and consequently it cannot be said that the will is clothed in the deed
(for the matter of clothing is specifically in something comparable),
and therefore the will in the deed is a will that is not clothed and not composed in any thing.
And through the performance of mitzvos, an elevation is also added to the understanding and comprehension of Torah,
as it is written,
“Good taste and knowledge teach me, for I have believed in Your mitzvos,”
that through the fulfillment of mitzvos
(in Your mitzvos),
and especially when the fulfillment of mitzvos is not for the sake of reason and intention, but only out of simple faith
(“I have believed”),
one attains the good taste and knowledge that are in Torah.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the revelation in Gan Eden is the inner G-dliness of Torah, while the revelation of Ein Sof through mitzvos will be in the future, described as “mountains of spices,” and that the revelation of the encompassing and Essence comes through the prior light of the filling.

translations.translation: And this is “You who sit in gardens… flee my beloved… upon the mountains of spices,”
for behold, it is known
that the revelation in Gan Eden is
(primarily)
that which is revealed to the souls, the inwardness and G-dliness of the Torah that they studied below,
in contrast, the revelation of Ein Sof that is drawn through the mitzvos,
this will be revealed primarily in the future,
for “there is no reward for mitzvos in this world,”
for then there will be the revelation of the encompassing light,
and even higher than that, there will be the revelation of the Essence.
And this is that the revelations of the future are called “mountains of spices,”
meaning mountains that are in the heavens,
“heavens” are the encompassing of all worlds,
and “mountains that are in the heavens”
(that even in the heavens they are mountains,
prominent)
is the matter of the revelation of the Essence that is above even the encompassing.
And about this it says “flee my beloved… upon the mountains of spices,”
for the revelation of the filling
(that is in Gan Eden)
relative to the revelation of the encompassing
(“heavens”)
and certainly relative to the revelation of the Essence
(“mountains of spices”)
is utterly incomparable
[for relative to the Essence,
even the encompassing is incomparable.
And as it is written,
“You have done many things… Your wonders and Your thoughts toward us, there is no comparison to You,”
“many” are all the categories of revelations of encompassing and filling,
which are called “many” in the manner of what is said in the Zohar,
“What are ‘many’? Great supernal and mighty ones,”
and about this it says “You have done many things,”
that all the revelations,
even though they are “many”
(supernal and mighty),
they are like “doing” relative to Him.
And the verse continues “Your wonders and Your thoughts,”
“Your wonders” are the revelations of the encompassing
(“wonder,”
above hishtalshelus)
and “Your thoughts” are the revelations of the filling,
and it says that all the revelation of “Your wonders and Your thoughts” is only “toward us,”
but relative to Him they are incomparable,
“there is no comparison to You.”
And their drawing,
“I will tell and speak”
(telling and speaking are the matter of drawing),
from the Essence of Ein Sof,
is through many tzimtzumim,
“He Himself is the number.”]
And since the encompassing and certainly the Essence are above revelation,
therefore their revelation in the future is through the precedence of the light of the filling
(that shines in Gan Eden)
whose matter
(of the light of the filling)
is revelation,
and therefore specifically through it,
even matters that in themselves are in the category of concealment,
are drawn into revelation.
